scope: Standing Holy Trinity Cathedral (Kidist Selassie), Addis Ababa, including the western seven-arched entrance and stone steps, towers and finials, the main nave, dome and eastern sanctuary.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The cathedral was reconsecrated on 14 January 2025 after extensive restoration.
The Addis Ababa Urban Heritage Database describes the eclectic cathedral, rooftop saints and angels, and the original imperial commission.

The cathedral records a 16 m building height in its description of the 1943 phase. The entry also dates the present expanded form to 1964. The recorded 16 m dimension informed the nave roof, with current dome and finial heights estimated.
The 2021 restoration scope identifies the copper roof dome, metal roofing, fluted stone columns, bas-reliefs, statues, stained glass and stone steps.
The structural assessment describes three construction phases and a steel-and-timber dome framed over masonry and clad in copper sheets.
